evidence: StepSummaryPanel.tsx:141 hidden lg:block; accordion variant (:124) is never rendered (GuidedActivationWizard.tsx:213,281)
recommendation: Render variant='accordion' below the footer for <lg.
resolution: StepSummaryPanel variant="accordion" mounted below lg in both wizard layouts; verified at 900px.

title: Field, checkbox and card borders are below 3:1
evidence: --field-border #e0e0e0 ~1.3:1 on white (tokens.css:107,125); unchecked Checkbox/Radio (Checkbox.tsx:37, Radio.tsx:31); --field-card-border #c9ced4 ~1.6:1
recommendation: ~#8a8a8a (3.4:1) for control borders; design sign-off needed because it changes the visual language.

title: Custom widgets have incomplete ARIA/keyboard support
count: Select, GlobalSearch, PersonaSwitcher popups, CustomerActionsMenu, FilterSelect
evidence: Select.tsx:121-124,159-170,212 (no aria-controls/activedescendant, focus not restored, no Home/End); GlobalSearch.tsx:224-237; PersonaSwitcher.tsx:252,266 (aria-haspopup=menu on a plain div; no Escape/focus return); CustomerActionsMenu.tsx:107-125
recommendation: One Combobox/Menu primitive (C-04).

title: Field ids derive from labels; six selects have no accessible name
evidence: Input.tsx:40, Select.tsx:65, Textarea.tsx:10, LocationInput.tsx:37 (input-undefined, duplicate ids); unnamed: PersonaSwitcher.tsx:282 (orphan label :281), TicketsDashboard.tsx:244,251,257, TicketActionsCard.tsx:52, TaskDetailView.tsx:166
recommendation: useId in every primitive; make label|aria-label|aria-labelledby required in the prop types.
resolution: LocationInput and ContactPhoneInput use useId and no longer produce input-undefined ids; Input/Select/Textarea and the six unnamed selects remain.

title: Required, invalid and error announcements are partial
evidence: only Input sets aria-invalid; Input errors lack role=alert; no error summary or focus-first-error; 5 autoComplete and 2 inputMode attributes (SC 1.3.5)
recommendation: FieldShell (C-11); autocomplete/inputMode on name, email, tel, bday fields.
resolution: LocationInput and ContactPhoneInput errors are role=alert, linked by aria-describedby, with aria-invalid; other primitives remain.

title: Login is not a form
evidence: LoginPage.tsx:163,172,193 div + onKeyDown, no autoComplete, error not described, Help button lacks aria-expanded (:~224)
recommendation: <form onSubmit>, type=submit, autoComplete=username/current-password, aria-describedby for the error.

title: Login carousel auto-advances with no pause control
evidence: LoginAnnouncements.tsx:70,92-93,113,137-143 (hover-only pause, 10px dots, role=tab without panel)
recommendation: Pause/play button, pause on focus-within, no auto-advance under reduced motion, 24px hit area.

title: Qnomy Finish/Abandon act without confirmation; disabled primary is faked
evidence: SessionReferenceNumbers.tsx:386,394; Customer360Layout.tsx:574 opacity-40 + no-op onClick
recommendation: Confirm Abandon in Modal; use aria-disabled; rename to 'Abandon customer' / 'Finish servicing'.

title: Disabled Continue gives no reason
evidence: WizardFooter.tsx:50 canProceed; CrossSalesStep.tsx:224 explains via title= only; disabled fill #ffb3b3 with white text 1.7:1
recommendation: aria-disabled + aria-describedby hint ('Complete Customer type to continue').

title: Tooltips fail hoverable/persistent and hide critical content
evidence: tooltip.css:24 pointer-events:none; tooltips on non-focusable divs (SessionReferenceNumbers.tsx:~359,406,427); only instruction text for Customer view is in a tooltip (WizardStepHeader.tsx:47); Tooltip.tsx:191 overwrites aria-describedby
recommendation: Hoverable surface, merge describedby, move essential text out of tooltips.

title: Toasts: live region injected with content; Escape/click-outside dismiss all and close dialogs
evidence: Toast.tsx:144-165,188,218,333 (dismiss buttons lack type/focus ring, 16-20px)
recommendation: Permanent live-region container; dismiss only the focused toast; 24px targets.

title: Dialogs: background not inert, scroll not locked, aria-label instead of labelledby
evidence: useDialogBehaviour.ts; Modal.tsx:37-48; Drawer.tsx:59-63; <main> scrolls behind the backdrop; drawer slide has no motion-reduce
recommendation: inert siblings, overscroll lock, aria-labelledby, motion-reduce.

title: Landmarks, breadcrumb semantics and heading order
evidence: PersonaSwitcher.tsx:100 header is a div; Breadcrumbs.tsx:43 not <nav aria-label><ol>, no aria-current; 'Back' uses navigate(-1)
recommendation: header/nav/search landmarks; breadcrumb list with aria-current='page'.

title: Tabs, tables and pager semantics incomplete
evidence: SegmentedTabs.tsx:42-62 no aria-controls/tabpanel; Tabs.tsx:60,130 vertical buttons lack role=tab/type, aria-current on <li>; DataTable.tsx:94,152-158 tr role=button, no scope/caption/aria-busy; C360Kit.tsx:341 focusable tr; only 1 of 10 tables has a caption
recommendation: Row link in first cell instead of role=button; scope=col; caption/aria-label; status role for loading/empty.

title: Selectable-card roles and hidden file inputs
evidence: CustomerTypeStep.tsx:223, CrossSalesStep.tsx:137, FixedStepViews.tsx:62 (no roving tabindex/arrows, deselectable radios); MsisdnPicker.tsx:559,597 div role=button aria-pressed for single-select; file inputs CafDocumentUpload.tsx:142, PostpaidDiscountsPanel.tsx:142, AdditionalDocumentsUpload.tsx:150 focusable and unnamed (their off-screen drift that stretched the scroll area is already fixed in the working tree by position:relative on <main>, App.tsx:84, uncommitted)
recommendation: Radio group semantics; tabIndex=-1 aria-hidden or label on file inputs.

title: Signature pad has no keyboard or text alternative
evidence: SignaturePad.tsx:59-67 bare canvas, pointer-only; coordinates not scaled below 480px
recommendation: Label + instructions + 'type name to sign' alternative (needs legal sign-off for CAF).

title: No global prefers-reduced-motion handling
evidence: Drawer slide, LoginAnnouncements timer, scrollIntoView smooth (C360OffersLeads.tsx:28, PostpaidPlanAddonsStep.tsx:191), Spinner role=status without text
recommendation: One global media query; announce spinners with sr-only text.

title: Contrast in usage: disabled text, translucent white, links
evidence: --field-label-disabled #b2b2b2 ~2.1:1; Select.tsx:177 text-white/35; plain text-link in body copy has no underline (PersonaSwitcher.tsx:242); primary gradient left stop #e53326 vs white ~4.35:1 at 14px bold; --accent on --page-bg 4.37:1 (prior audit residual 1)
recommendation: Raise disabled text to >=3:1 (exempt) but keep readable; underline inline links; decide accent text on tinted page.

title: Smaller interaction defects
evidence: single-key '/' shortcut without off switch (Dashboard.tsx:82); Customer view button combines aria-pressed with a changing label (WizardStepHeader.tsx:51-66); sidebar toggle flips aria-label and aria-expanded (NavLogoToggle.tsx, Sidebar.tsx:394); mobile sidebar drawer lacks dialog behaviour (Sidebar.tsx:214); theme toggle has no aria-pressed; notifications marked read on open (PersonaSwitcher.tsx:77)
recommendation: Fix individually.

title: 31 <button> without type; Button has no default type
evidence: LoginPage.tsx:221, Toast.tsx:212,295, Tabs.tsx:58, GlobalSearch.tsx:252,269, ModuleScreenList.tsx:174, ...; the existing guard misses them
recommendation: Default type='button' in Button; fix the guard (T-17).
resolution: Button defaults to type="button"; 34 raw buttons typed; the guard now parses JSX and checks every file.

title: Small targets and read-only inputs that cannot be copied
evidence: toast dismiss 16-20px; SearchField clear ~16px (SearchField.tsx:41); carousel dots 10px; Input.tsx:67-85 read-only is tabIndex=-1/select-none so agents cannot copy values
recommendation: 24px minimum targets; allow selection on read-only values.
